connector.name: Kenda
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for querying Kenda token spend and waste
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ingestion-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kenda-co account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KENDA_ENDPOINT
env.description: Kenda API base URL, e.g. https://api.kenda.app. Optional: normally read from ~/.kenda/config.json, which `kenda-collect init` writes. Set this to override the file.

env.name: KENDA_TOKEN
env.description: Per-customer Kenda ingest token (kenda_...). Optional: normally read from ~/.kenda/config.json. Set this to override the file.
